title: Beyond Final Answers: Interpretable Tumor Immune Microenvironment Reasoning from H&E and mIF
abstract: arXiv:2611.26794v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Readouts of the tumor immune microenvironment (TIME), such as CD8+ T-cell density, intra-epithelial infiltration and the Ki67 index, combine tissue architecture from H&E with cell phenotypes from multiplex immunofluorescence (mIF). Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) could automate these readouts with an explanation, but two gaps remain. Pathology MLLMs read H&E alone, while these readouts need the cell phenotypes that mIF measures. And their reasoning has no step-level truth to be checked against, so R1-style reinforcement learning rewards only the final answer and leaves the reasoning unverified. Same-section H&E and mIF provide what both gaps lack: mIF measures every cell without manual annotation, which gives cell-level ground truth for each step that clinical guidelines prescribe, from delineating a tissue compartment to counting and normalizing the marker-positive cells within it. translated_title: 超越最终答案：基于H&E与mIF的可解释肿瘤免疫微环境推理
translated_abstract: 肿瘤免疫微环境（TIME）的读出指标，如CD8+ T细胞密度、上皮内浸润和Ki67指数，需要结合来自H&E的组织结构信息与来自多重免疫荧光（mIF）的细胞表型信息。多模态大语言模型（MLLM）有望通过给出解释来自动化这些读出指标，但目前仍存在两个空白：其一，现有病理学MLLM仅读取H&E，而这些读出指标依赖mIF才能测量的细胞表型；其二，其推理过程缺乏步骤级的真值可供验证，因此R1式强化学习只奖励最终答案，推理过程本身未被验证。同一切片的H&E与mIF恰好填补了这两个空白：mIF无需人工标注即可测量每一个细胞，从而为临床指南所规定的每个步骤——从描绘组织区室到计数并标准化其中的标志物阳性细胞——提供细胞级的真值。基于此，我们提出了HERMES（H&E-mIF推理……）。
tldr: 该论文提出HERMES，利用同一切片的H&E与mIF图像提供免人工标注的细胞级真值，使多模态大语言模型的肿瘤免疫微环境推理获得步骤级可验证的可解释监督，而非仅验证最终答案。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces HERMES, which leverages same-section H&E and mIF images to provide annotation-free cell-level ground truth, enabling step-level verifiable and interpretable tumor immune microenvironment reasoning in multimodal LLMs rather than rewarding only final answers.
